Settings.ApiKeyDescription: Required for AssemblyAI transcription and streaming.
Settings.ModelDescription: Choose the AssemblyAI speech model. Universal-3.5 Pro covers 18 languages and Universal-2 about 100. Real-time dictation uses Universal-3.6 Pro Streaming with Universal-3.5 Pro, and Universal-Streaming with Universal-2 when English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese or Italian is selected; with automatic detection or other languages, Universal-2 transcribes after recording.
Settings.UseDictionaryTermsDescription: Biases transcription toward your dictionary terms, each sent whole (commas included). AssemblyAI charges extra for keyterms on recorded audio and in English real-time dictation with Universal-2; other real-time dictation includes them. Real-time dictation sends at most 100 terms of up to 50 characters. When off, AssemblyAI receives no dictionary terms.
Settings.SpeakerLabelsDescription: Starts each utterance with its speaker ("Speaker A: …") and keeps utterance timestamps. AssemblyAI charges extra. Turns off real-time dictation, so text appears after recording.
Settings.NotConfiguredApiKeyRequired: Plugin not configured. API key required.
Manifest.Name: AssemblyAI
Manifest.Description: AssemblyAI Universal-3.5 Pro and Universal-2 transcription engine
